purpose: Document first-party Arua/Uganda land-registry discovery and bounded anonymous UgNLIS geometry-access review.
assessment: Arua City and MLHUD provide first-party evidence of local and national land-registration/cadastral responsibilities. The current public UgNLIS portal exposes parcel-related API routes, but bounded anonymous requests did not return parcel identity-plus-geometry data.
registryAssessment: Arua City Physical Planning and Housing Department is a documented local custodian for land registration and cadastral mapping functions; MLHUD's UgNLIS identifies an Arua MZO. registryFound is true for source discovery only.

Official MLHUD page describes UgNLIS as a spatially referenced land-information system and lists Arua among its Ministry Zonal Offices.
Current public portal loaded successfully; its HTML references the current JavaScript bundle inspected for API/configuration routes.
Official MLHUD department page documents cadastral-job quality checks, survey/mapping responsibilities and survey-data services.
